basic_info.description: Situated in a boutique building in sought-after Mission Dolores, this 2BD/2.5BA contemporary condo with rare 2-car parking presents a wonderful opportunity to own a turn-key, beautifully designed home in a prime location. The home's main level welcomes you with an open floor plan featuring a lovely kitchen with stone counters, breakfast bar, and gas range with hood, a combined living and dining area with wide-plank wood floors, corner fireplace, and floor to ceiling windows that bathe the space in natural light, and a convenient half bath. The two bedrooms, including a spacious primary suite with dual closets, are located on the lower level as are the two luxe full baths. In-unit laundry and private storage, too. Building amenities include an expansive roof deck with panoramic views and an elevator. Fantastic location in one of the City's most vibrant neighborhoods, known for its warm weather and anchored by 16-acre Dolores Park. Enjoy the local art scene and myriad of food, drink and local shopping options, such as Tartine Bakery, L'Ardoise Bistro, and Whole Foods, that surround you. Easy access to MUNI public transit for those heading to the Financial District or Downtown, and to Highways 101 and 280 for longer commutes.
